en.title: OpenAI API now supports 12-hour prompt caching, with caches retained permanently for Codex and Work users
en.summary: OpenAI's developer account announced that the API now offers optional 12-hour prompt caching, allowing continuously running agents to reuse instructions, tools, and context at the lower cached input rate even when requests are hours apart. Tibo added that for logged-in users, caches in Codex and Work are retained permanently—returning to an old conversation or resuming a session hours later is guaranteed to hit the cache, with no extra penalty.
en.reason: OpenAI's API now offers an optional 12-hour prompt cache so long-running agents can reuse instructions, tools and context at lower cached-input rates, while Codex and Work keep logged-in users' caches permanently, with no penalty for resuming old conversations hours later.

en.summary: Google and Meta release TorchTPU, an open-source project providing a native PyTorch backend for Google TPU—migrating models requires only changing .to("cuda") to .to("tpu").
en.reason: Google and Meta's open-source TorchTPU gives Google TPUs a native PyTorch backend with eager execution, begun in mid-2025, letting existing workloads switch from .to("cuda") to .to("tpu") and already serving Google Cloud large-customer production training and inference.
